Long, elegant platinum-blonde hair with a neat side parting and a sleek texture. Sharp, almond-shaped deep crimson eyes with a sophisticated expression. Apparent age of 24 with a mature, poised demeanor. Slender, graceful build. A formal white and gold military dress with a long flowing cape and a high collar. Includes a large, ornate white and gold naval rigging system with heavy cannons.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
